source_contract.scope: Existing provider launch, scheduler/integration boundaries, frozen-taskpack project-root plumbing, projection, release binding, post-backlog gates, and P0 readiness validation.
exclusions: This handoff is implementation guidance, not benchmark evidence.
It must not be supplied to single_codex mode.
It does not replace the immutable protocol, run manifest, release binding, or gate epoch.

sequence: caller builds command and classifies it with is_supported_codex_command
ModelInvocationCall.execute performs the common prelaunch policy
ModelInvocationCall.finalize writes terminal usage and performs post-terminal accounting
worker provider lifecycle is imported by collect_ready_results
agentteam gate state publishes a digest-chained epoch
a controller creates and registers evidence against the epoch

known_absences: No experiment_protocol.v1 or experiment_run_manifest.v2 execution path exists yet.
No common launch-policy or global experiment-budget callback exists on ModelInvocationCall.
No trusted frozen-taskpack project-root override exists.
No experiment result tables or comparison reader exist in projection_db.py.
post_backlog_gates declarations carry relation_validator and controller_entrypoint, but current gate execution does not dispatch either field.
Blueprint, taskpack, and agent-pool validation currently reject an empty model backlog/controller-only taskpack.

current_contract: Supported Codex calls use a gated systemd supervisor.
started.json is durable before the launch permit.
Terminal usage becomes authoritative only in InvocationLifecycle.finalize.
Fake commands use the same lifecycle but bypass systemd and spawn in _run_bounded_process.
phase2_insertion_order: Keep supported-command classification at the caller.
Inside ModelInvocationCall.execute, after classification and before SystemdGatedExecution.prepare or _run_bounded_process, apply one immutable experiment launch descriptor.
The descriptor must perform protocol-global lease and budget admission before any provider process can exist.
The same descriptor must supply the bwrap command, exact cwd, and bounded environment for both supported and deterministic fake paths.
After InvocationLifecycle.finalize returns authoritative terminal usage, invoke post-terminal budget accounting exactly once.
common_launch_seam.do_not_split: Sandbox policy, provider-lane lease, and prelaunch budget admission must be one common ModelInvocationCall policy. Scheduler-only wrapping misses authoring, repo-map, follow-up, direct-mode, diagnostic, and future controller calls.

call_site_inventory.note: Primary worker path constructed by the scheduler.
Used by normal authoring and therefore by agentteam_full.
Out-of-band provider use must be denied or explicitly accounted while a scored experiment binding is active.
Existing epoch-bound live acceptance path and negative authorization reference.

context_extension.required_change: Carry immutable experiment protocol/run identity and admit registered experiment-controller usage stages without overloading implementation_run_id/gate_epoch.
context_extension.current_constraint: _validate_call_context currently reserves implementation_run_id and gate_epoch for acceptance_live_smoke and rejects them on other stages.

spawn_environment_gap.current_state: Both Popen paths inherit the host environment; the supervisor spec contains command, cwd, input, timeout, and spool limit but no explicit environment.
spawn_environment_gap.required_change: Thread one validated environment map through the supervisor spec and both Popen paths, or prove the bwrap wrapper fully clears and rebuilds the environment.

integration_risks: Applying bwrap only in CodexRuntimeAdapter.run leaves taskpack author and controller paths unsandboxed.
Running admission after SystemdGatedExecution.prepare creates provider-side execution authority before budget or lease approval.
Accounting before terminalization can infer or double-count incomplete provider usage.
Adding experiment fields without extending start/terminal projections loses the binding during replay.
A host-inherited environment can leak evaluator paths or credentials despite a correct mount namespace.

budget_safe_boundaries.action: Acquire the protocol-global provider lease and run budget admission before preparing or spawning a provider.
Consume only authoritative terminal usage, persist warning/exhaustion once, and expose one-lane overshoot.
Check stop state after result validation and before the first integration mutation. A stopped run may retain the accepted patch without beginning integration.
Complete apply, verification, commit, rollback, event publication, and baseline update as one uninterrupted transaction; only then persist budget_stopped.

reuse: dispatch_ready is the admission point for new worker attempts.
collect_ready_results already imports durable invocation lifecycles before accepting results.
reconcile_orphaned_invocation already distinguishes live ambiguous work from proven-dead execution.
scheduler_drain_and_resume.required_change: Budget exhaustion must disable dispatch, keep collection and reconciliation active until all inflight calls terminalize, then transition to durable budget_stopped. Interruption resume must reload the original budget snapshot rather than reinitialize counters.

reusable_contract: Epoch records are digest chained and schema validated.
Receipts bind implementation run, epoch digest, gate ID, evidence run, evidence schema, and integration head.
Gate schema is read from the committed integration head.
Integration fails closed until every gate passes.
post_backlog_gate_core.phase2_gap: The declaration fields relation_validator and controller_entrypoint are preserved by materialization but ignored by _evaluate_one_post_backlog_gate and _post_backlog_gate_next_action. P1-06E relations are hard-coded instead.

required_change: Resolve controller_entrypoint and relation_validator through a closed registry in experiment_gates.py; never import arbitrary declaration strings.
For P2-08, run the deterministic controller, register its evidence, and continue automatically.
For P2-09, publish an epoch-bound authorization request and pause before any provider call; resume only after the immutable authorization artifact passes the declared schema and relation validator.
For P2-10, run the deterministic finalization controller and complete automatically after its relation validator passes.
automatic_gate_progression.write_scope_constraint: P2-07B cannot modify cli.py. The controller-only branch must be selected in agentteam.py before _run_frozen_taskpack delegates to agentteam_runtime.cli.

controller_lifecycle_reuse.required_change: Register Phase 2 gate/live-calibration controller stages and claims at fixed run-relative roots so status, projection, and open-controller fencing see the same durable lifecycle.

integration_risks: A stop check inside _integrate_accepted_result can interrupt apply/verify/commit and corrupt the baseline.
Marking budget_stopped while inflight invocations remain open loses terminal usage and violates drain-before-stop.
Trusting schema-valid gate strings without calling the declared relation validator repeats the P0-A gap.
Treating P2-09 like the current operator_review_required flow is insufficient: authorization must exist before the live provider call, not after evidence exists.
Launching a zero-backlog promotion taskpack through the worker-pool CLI path either fails validation or starts unnecessary model workers.

primary_seam.current_behavior: Reads project_root from frozen taskpack.yaml and emits it as --project-root to agentteam_runtime.cli.
primary_seam.required_change: Add a controller-supplied trusted_project_root_override used only for the emitted runtime --project-root. Validate it as a resolved Git repository and keep the frozen taskpack bytes unchanged.

caller_seam.required_change: Only experiment_modes.agentteam_direct may pass the sanitized snapshot root through _run_frozen_taskpack. Ordinary CLI run/continue retain declared-root behavior.

rules: Validate and hash the reviewed taskpack before applying the root override.
Compare the protocol-declared direct-taskpack digest to the frozen artifact inventory.
Do not rewrite taskpack.yaml project_root, because that changes the reviewed digest.
Do not expose the override as an untrusted taskpack field or general worker-controlled CLI flag.
Bind the override to the clean-reset attestation and exact protocol commit/tree before runtime launch.

controller_only_conflicts.current_state: agents and tasks both require at least one item.
Blueprint validation assumes task ancestors; generated agent_pool and backlog assume model work; validate_taskpack rejects empty agents and empty backlog.
Every gated taskpack is delegated to daemon two-phase worker-pool execution.

taskpack_snapshot_root_override.controller_only_required_invariant: Permit empty tasks/agents only for an explicit controller-only form with a non-empty deterministic post_backlog_gates list, committed schemas, closed registry entrypoints and relation validators, approval binding to the candidate release, and no path into model worker dispatch.
integration_risks: Mutating taskpack.yaml to point at the snapshot invalidates the preregistered direct-taskpack digest.
Applying the override before validating the declared taskpack can conceal a stale or malicious original root.
A general CLI override allows ordinary runs or workers to redirect integration outside the attested snapshot.
Relaxing empty-backlog validation without the controller-only predicate creates taskpacks that falsely complete without model work or deterministic gates.

projection.current_authority_model: Files and canonical events are authoritative; agentteam.db is replaced from a full scan and checked by counts plus content digests.
phase2_extension: Scan immutable protocol/run bindings, operator ledger entries, recovery metadata, and sealed result bundles from the experiment root.
Add experiment run/result rows keyed by protocol digest, run ID, mode, repetition, terminal status, and result-bundle digest.
Project unsuccessful and budget-stopped bundles; never filter them at scan time.
Include experiment totals and bundle digests in _projection_counts and _database_counts so rebuild equality is mechanically checkable.
Keep raw spools and the SQLite file outside authoritative artifact-byte totals.

reuse: Candidate releases are immutable exported trees with manifest-bound source commit and Git object format.
Blueprint materialization already requires the approval-bound active release to match ID and source commit.
Implementation runs already bind a selected release before the runtime child starts.
release.phase2_boundary: P2-07B finishes under the preflight release. Only after operator installation/activation of the integration commit may a separately approved controller-only promotion blueprint bind and execute the candidate release.

phase2_extension: P2-08 must recompute all seven capability evidence bindings, readiness before/after digests, pilot manifest binding, and zero provider-call/target-mutation guard before changing only the packaged readiness record.
P2-09 must bind current gate epoch, P2-08 receipt, protocol, model/reasoning, immutable budgets, one provider lane, and exactly three unique modes before any live call.
P2-10 must verify a single-parent final report descendant whose exact changed paths are the roadmap and Phase 2 report.
Keep legacy agentteam_experiment_manifest.v1 validation-only; do not route Phase 2 execution through validate_experiment_manifest.

cli_surface.current_state: Experiment CLI exposes only readiness, legacy manifest validation, and pilot guard; DB CLI already exposes rebuild/check.
cli_surface.phase2_extension: P2-06 adds run/resume/show/compare dispatch to experiment_controller/results while preserving existing readiness commands.

integration_risks: Making agentteam.db authoritative lets projection loss or staleness change experiment truth.
Omitting failed/interrupted/budget-stopped bundles biases comparison output.
Using the mutable active-release pointer after run binding permits release drift.
Attempting to hot-load P2-07B from the implementation run violates the two-taskpack release boundary.
Schema validation alone does not prove Git ancestry, exact changed paths, evidence digests, or zero-provider-call guards.

l2_task_map.objective: Enforce bwrap provider isolation, evaluator-only canary denial, trusted argv evaluation, and leakage scanning.
required_tests: Exact worker namespace cannot read canary content or canary path.
Supported worker, authoring, repo-map, follow-up, and direct-mode calls all use the same launch policy.
Unsafe mount/environment additions fail before durable provider start.
Acceptance runs only after all terminal invocation records exist and uses argv without shell execution.
Bounded prompt/context/taskpack/artifact scans detect canary or digest leakage.
Cleanup failure preserves the sealed result bundle.
highest_risks: evaluator data mounted into provider namespace

l2_task_map.objective: Integrate global budget admission, drain, stop, and interruption recovery at provider and scheduler safe boundaries.
required_tests: Exhaustion before launch yields zero additional provider starts.
One inflight invocation may overshoot and its authoritative total remains visible.
Exhaustion drains inflight work before durable budget_stopped.
A pre-integration stop preserves the accepted patch without mutating the baseline.
A stop observed during integration is deferred until apply/verify/commit or rollback completes.
Interruption resume reloads original consumption and rejects scored budget extension.
highest_risks: run-local rather than protocol-global provider locking

l2_task_map.objective: Run single_codex, agentteam_direct, and agentteam_full through one controller, evaluator, finalizer, and provider lane.
required_tests: All three adapters receive the same commit/tree, goal, constraints, acceptance, environment, model/reasoning, seed, budgets, and operator limits.
single_codex performs exactly one fresh invocation and receives no taskpack or repo-map context.
agentteam_direct verifies the preregistered taskpack digest and uses only the attested snapshot root override.
agentteam_full cannot read the direct taskpack and performs normal author/freeze/run/follow-up orchestration.
Seeded counterbalanced order is deterministic and cannot change after results.
Every adapter returns the same lifecycle result shape to the common evaluator/finalizer without live calls in unit tests.
highest_risks: snapshot root override exposed to workers

l2_task_map.objective: Implement executable Phase 2 relation validators, epoch-bound live authorization, and controller-only promotion taskpacks.
required_tests: Controller-only blueprint accepts zero tasks/agents only with non-empty deterministic gates and candidate-release approval binding.
P2-08 recomputes evidence digests, readiness counts, pilot binding, zero provider calls, zero target mutations, and exact one-path change.
P2-09 rejects duplicate modes, stale epoch authorization, protocol/readiness/model drift, and budget extension before any provider call.
A valid immutable authorization resumes the same epoch deterministically and permits the bounded live controller.
P2-10 accepts only the single-parent exact two-path report commit relation.
Gate artifacts are create-if-absent, digest-bound, and idempotent; conflicting replay fails closed.
The implementation taskpack completes without executing newly integrated controllers; only the activated candidate release runs the promotion taskpack.
highest_risks: empty backlog falsely treated as ordinary completion
